class ats_utilities.generation.scheme.ischeme_loader.ISchemeLoader(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Defines the ISchemeLoader abstract class with method(s). Provides an interface for loading and resolving generation scheme.

It defines:

methods:
load - Loads and resolves the scheme from dict or path.
is_initialized - Checks if scheme loader is initialized.
__str__ - Returns the scheme loader as a string representation.
